name: route53profiles
description: With Amazon Route 53 Profiles you can share Route 53 configurations with VPCs and AWS accounts

subcommands.name: associate-profile
subcommands.description: Associates a Route 53 Profiles profile with a VPC.

subcommands.name: associate-resource-to-profile
subcommands.description: Associates a DNS reource configuration to a Route 53 Profile.

subcommands.name: disassociate-profile
subcommands.description: Dissociates a specified Route 53 Profile from the specified VPC.

subcommands.name: disassociate-resource-from-profile
subcommands.description: Dissoaciated a specified resource, from the Route 53 Profile.

subcommands.name: get-profile
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specified Route 53 Profile, such as whether whether the Profile is shared, and the current status of the Profile.

subcommands.name: get-profile-association
subcommands.description: Retrieves a Route 53 Profile association for a VPC.

subcommands.name: get-profile-resource-association
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specified Route 53 Profile resource association.

subcommands.name: list-profile-associations
subcommands.description: Lists all the VPCs that the specified Route 53 Profile is associated with.

subcommands.name: list-profile-resource-associations
subcommands.description: Lists all the resource associations for the specified Route 53 Profile.

subcommands.name: list-profiles
subcommands.description: Lists all the Route 53 Profiles associated with your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags that you associated with the specified resource.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to a specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from a specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-profile-resource-association
subcommands.description: Updates the specified Route 53 Profile resourse association.
